comment: Every item must be covered by a passing result, or carry a waiver, in at least one report attached to the release candidate. Section numbers refer to docs/SHIMMER3_TEST_PROCEDURE.md. Gate 1 is not listed: CI runs it on every pull request and push, and the release workflow builds on top of that commit, changing only the version. Nor is the build: a candidate exists only if it built. The rest of gate 2 is read off the candidate's build, so it is listed: its warnings and its size. The boot matrix row covers each radio firmware that shipped to customers.

items.title: The candidate's build warnings read for 16-bit int arithmetic
Flash and RAM recorded and compared with the previous release
Factory self-test read and checked against the board revision
Boot matrix: one unit per shipped radio firmware (RN42 v4.77, RN42 v6.15, RN4678 v1.00.5, RN4678 v1.23.0), banners recorded
Per-model behaviour walked on the models the change touches
Rest of gate 4 walked on at least one unit
Shipping host stack against the release candidate
A recording from the previous release still imports
Version skew walked in both directions
Any compatibility change made loud: version bumped, document and host reference updated, host version named in the release notes
Regression cases considered against what changed
